reason: The remediation only edits a PAM password quality configuration parameter (difok) to enforce a minimum number of differing characters when changing passwords. This is a standard STIG hardening step, does not affect system boot or critical services, and is unlikely to cause lockout if set to a reasonable value.
estimated_impact: authentication/authorization affected; Improperly low difok value could reduce password strength; Improperly high difok value could cause user password change failures
